name: fullstack-auth-module
description: Thin root: convenience scripts that delegate to the two independent apps in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix e2e
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
